The team that stops attacks before they strike

Malanta gives organizations the foresight to prevent breaches, not just respond to them. Our patented Pre-Attack Prevention Platform detects attacker infrastructure, exposes exploitable assets, and neutralizes threats before they go live.

Why We Exist

Attacks are built
before they strike

Every attack starts with infrastructure. domains, servers, phishing kits - assembled days or hours in advance. With AI-driven bots scaling faster than ever, reactive security can’t keep up. Malanta stops threats upstream, before they reach your environment.

Our Approach

From signal to action

We fuse global threat scanning with your internal context to surface only action-ready risks - reducing noise and empowering decisive defense.

Our Mission

Stop attacks at
the source

Move security from reactive to proactive. Empower teams to defend at machine speed.

Our Vision

A world where breaches are prevented,
not reacted to.

Where security teams stay ahead of attackers, focusing on stopping threats, not chasing alerts.
